findings.text: the fragment states that a queued request drops over_fence_reason because _node_from_pointer rebuilds the node field by field without naming it, but _node_from_pointer iterates fields(TaskNode) at reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:228 and carries every declared field; a stored node rebuilt through it returns over_fence_reason unchanged, so the outside-scope claim, repeated in the manifest, names a defect that does not exist and would drive a needless repair node

the arms table records the after arm at b1754bab while the log the manifest cites for it, logs/after-arm.log, carries the header '# revision: ea4b01e2b07c', so the table's revision column disagrees with the receipt it points a reader at

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against c4eff770 (a63f92f5e7, 6e20309d5b, b1754bab09, ea4b01e2b0); two files changed, +94 lines, no production module touched
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py and a base-vs-after no-new-failure arm; baseline_suite and after_suite carry that exact command with 58 passed at c4eff770 and 60 passed at ea4b01e2, and logs/base-arm.log and logs/after-arm.log each end in a bare EXIT=0 line
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a brief can raise the budget fence with a recorded reason; the diff adds the arms at tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py:275 and :298 on top of the base arms at :159 and :177 that already pass and carry the reason onto the node
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records 58 passed at base with no failure added, the declared control at 3 failed 57 passed EXIT=1 and a strip probe at 1 failed 8 passed EXIT=1, and one outside-scope claim that the production code does not support
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths were reckon/crew/node.py, tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py and the evidence fragment; the diff touches only the test file and the fragment, and node.py is untouched because the bounded check at reckon/crew/node.py:1508 already read node.over_fence_reason.strip()

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py:275 reddens when strip is dropped from reckon/crew/node.py:1508 and :298 reddens when the reason clause is ignored, shown in logs/strip-probe.log and logs/negative-control.log.
justifications.evidence: logs/base-arm.log and logs/after-arm.log carry revision, tree and command on their header lines and a terminal EXIT=0 line, though the fragment's arms table names a different after-arm revision than the cited log.
justifications.fit: both added tests build a TaskNode and call validate_node exactly as the surrounding arm at tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py:177 does, and introduce no plan or ticket identifier.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the goal's behaviour is exercised at tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py:177 and :298, with the reason carried onto the node at :159.
justifications.reuse: the diff adds no production definition; the arms reuse TaskNode, validate_node, FENCE, OVER_BUDGET and REASON, and a search of reckon/crew for another over-fence admission mechanism found only the owner at reckon/crew/node.py:1508.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff is one of the node's declared write paths, tests/test_a_budget_may_exceed_its_fence_with_a_reason.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-gate-halts-only-on-substance/a-brief-can-raise-the-budget-fence-with-a-record.html.
